meta.note: Financial-year rounds (April to March), dated at April of the first year. Every row MoSPI publishes for this table, values as served, including its published "All" totals; each series is named by all of its dimensions. Per-1000 distributions are integers and can miss 1,000 by a few parts from rounding. Rupee values are nominal.
